description.text:
SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE — a fictional case used to test this production pipeline. Every person, place, and record is invented.

In November 1954 a mill payroll went missing from an office safe that showed no signs of force. Police alleged the bookkeeper opened it; he denied it, was charged, and a jury acquitted him in March 1955. As of April 1955 the money had not been recovered.

Sources are listed below. Illustrations are labeled on screen.
